# SenseVoice INT8 attribution and notices

SenseVoice is by Alibaba Group / the FunAudioLLM (now QwenAudio) and FunASR authors. The default model retains its upstream name: sherpa-onnx-sense-voice-zh-en-ja-ko-yue-int8-2024-07-17, converted and released by k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx. Exact archive and payload digests are in docs/spec/builtin-assets-v0.3.json.

The converted archive supplies ARCHIVE-LICENSE, a pointer to the FunASR license section. Preserve that original pointer. FunASR-LICENSE is the toolkit MIT license fetched from https://github.com/modelscope/FunASR/blob/main/LICENSE on 2026-10-15. MODEL_LICENSE is the separately named model-weight agreement from https://github.com/modelscope/FunASR/blob/58830eca4012644aac0c3218c3ccc7d98f003fda/MODEL_LICENSE, fetched on the same date. These separate texts are retained rather than describing all artifacts as MIT.

Model card snapshot source: https://modelscope.cn/models/iic/SenseVoiceSmall (2026-10-15). Its catalog metadata says Apache License 2.0; the original converted archive pointer and separately published model agreement are also retained because metadata alone does not establish every conversion's terms.

This file records source provenance; it does not replace the upstream licenses. No third-party checkpoint is represented as byte-identical to the original MAC-record bundle.
